level.title: Arm Your Minion
level.subdescription:
Your Minion takes orders well now. But every new chat is a blank slate — no memory, no context, back to square one.
Time to build them a permanent base. Load the instructions once, load 374 mission records once, and let them find the pattern nobody spotted.

mission_targets: Build a Claude Project — a permanent workspace your Minion never forgets
Load instructions and 374 mission records into it once, not every chat
Prove the memory works by asking a brand new chat what it already knows
Interrogate the data to answer the 5 mission questions and invent your special tool

mission_gear.name: Projects
mission_gear.definition: A permanent workspace in Claude that holds your instructions and your files, so every new chat inside it starts with your Minion already briefed.
mission_gear.theme_translation: Think of it as Gru's Lair. Without it, Gru would rebuild the entire operation from scratch every single morning. With it, everything is already in place the moment he walks in.
why_useful: Your Minion remembers who it is and what it knows
You stop re-explaining yourself in every new chat
Instructions and files are set once and reused forever
Everything for one piece of work stays in one place

mission_gear.name: Context
mission_gear.definition: The background you load into a Project — Claude calls this panel Context. Files, data, and instructions that tell your Minion about your world before you ask it anything.
mission_gear.theme_translation: Before any great heist, Gru briefs the team. Here is the target, here is what we know, here is what went wrong last time. Context is that briefing, delivered once and never repeated.
why_useful: Answers are grounded in your actual data, not general knowledge
Specific beats generic every single time
The more context you load, the sharper your Minion gets
Files, data, and instructions all count as context

mission_check: Created a Claude Project and named it after my Minion
Pasted the project instructions into the Project
Added the mission data file to the Project's Context
Found the best timing from the data (Q01)
Found the best ship from the data (Q02)
Found the optimal team size from the data (Q03)
Found the budget range from the data (Q04)
Found the biggest mission risk from the data (Q05)
My Minion invented a special tool for the mission
